tagline: An integrated energy company committed to sustainable energy transition and net-zero emissions by 2050.
hero_kpi_rationale: Capital investments reflect Repsol's structural commitment to energy transition and decarbonization. With 4.5 billion EUR in 2024 and an 11% year-over-year increase, CAPEX demonstrates the diversification strategy toward renewable energy and infrastructure modernization, aligned with the 2050 net-zero emissions objective.

kpis.name: Capital Investments
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in physical assets, including refining facilities, exploration-production infrastructure, and energy transition projects.
kpis.description: Sustained investments reflect Repsol's commitment to decarbonization and diversification toward renewable energy, consistent with the 2024-27 Strategic Plan and the scope 1+2+3 net-zero emissions target by 2050.
kpis.signal: CAPEX on the rise, oriented toward energy transition and renewable energy

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Margin between revenue and direct production costs, reflecting operational performance of refining and production activities.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects the operational performance of production and refining activities, sensitive to hydrocarbon prices and energy market conditions.
kpis.signal: Gross margin typical of an integrated energy company

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees employed by the group across all activities (exploration, production, refining, distribution).
kpis.description: Headcount of 24,500 employees remains elevated and stable, consistent with an integrated model covering exploration, production, refining, and energy distribution.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount despite ongoing energy transformation

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 54.86 billion EUR in the latest year

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Net income of 1.9 billion EUR in the latest year

risks.title: Energy transition and depreciation of petroleum assets
risks.score_rationale: Major risk in Item 1A (principal Key Audit Matter). Intensive language: stranded assets, impairment adjustments, Net Zero 2050 scenarios. Trend: UP (downward revisions in hydrocarbon prices 2024-2030). Weight: direct impact on E&P, Spanish refining, mobility.

risks.title: Venezuela geopolitical risk and OFAC sanctions
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated Key Audit Matter (note 26). Exposure of 504 million EUR (Cardón IV, Petroquiriquire). Language: high level of uncertainty, license revocation then reissuance by OFAC May 2024, US administration change January 2025. Trend: UP (increased uncertainty post-January 2025).

risks.title: Hydrocarbon price volatility and refining margins
risks.score_rationale: Central business risk in Item 1A. Language: high uncertainty, downward revisions in Brent/Henry Hub 2024-2030, Spanish refining margins impacted by Fit for 55 package. Trend: UP (downward revisions 2024). Weight: direct impact on E&P and refining cash flows.

risks.title: PDVSA credit risk and Venezuela receivables recovery
risks.score_rationale: Specific Key Audit Matter (note 26). Language: credit risk, expected credit losses model, independent expert engaged. Trend: UP (degraded PDVSA risk profile, local currency devaluation, inflation). Weight: PDVSA receivables included in current and non-current assets.

risks.title: Regulatory uncertainty on climate and carbon taxation
risks.score_rationale: Business risk in Item 1A. Language: legislative and tax developments, climate change, CO2 price path revised down 20% vs 2023. Trend: UP (Fit for 55, Repower EU regulations accelerate transition). Weight: impact on asset valuation, refining margins, hydrocarbon demand.

risks.title: Deferred tax asset recovery risk
risks.score_rationale: Key Audit Matter (note 7.3). Deferred tax assets of 4,405 million EUR, unused tax losses of 3,866 million EUR. Language: significant estimates, future taxable profits. Trend: STABLE (depends on future profitability and tax regulations). Weight: material but secondary vs energy transition.

risks.title: Dependence on future investments for natural gas production
risks.score_rationale: Business risk in Item 1A. Language: massive investment needs, natural gas as transition fuel. Trend: STABLE (long-term scenario). Weight: medium-term impact on production capacity and competitiveness.

risks.title: Risk of stranded assets before 2040
risks.score_rationale: Business risk in Item 1A. Language: stranded assets, recoverable before 2040. Trend: UP (Net Zero scenarios accelerate obsolescence). Weight: medium impact on E&P and refining portfolio.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence, cloud computing, or advanced digital technologies in the 10-K/20-F document. Repsol does not position AI as a major strategic lever; the strategy is centered on energy transition and decarbonization.
evidence: Key risks identified concern energy transition, hydrocarbon prices, and decarbonization, not technological disruption by AI.
R&D investments are not detailed in the provided documents.
Strategic focus areas pertain to exploration-production, refining, and renewable energy, not technology or AI.
